comparison.objective: Open a folding-table leg, secure its brace with a sliding ring, and prove the lock under side load.
comparison.physical_skill: Articulated linkage opening, sleeve/ring positioning over a knee, clearance, and load-proof sequencing.
comparison.success_condition: Leg within 1 degree of upright, ring at least 12 mm past the knee pin, hands clear, and no more than 3 degrees folding under a 6 N test.
comparison.reason: This is the closest functional pattern—adjust, lock, clear, and proof-load—but the tested ability is gross linkage deployment and ring locking. The candidate adds recessed hex-bit insertion, captive screw torque, withdrawal/re-engagement after collar motion, fine continuous tuning, and two energy/force/rebound-qualified impact cycles.
